info.name: Community Will API
info.description:
Postman collection for the currently implemented Community Will JSON/mobile API routes.

Notes:
- Import this collection together with community-will-local.postman_environment.json.
- Seeded test account: subscriber@gmail.com / password.
- Recommended demo setup order: Get Feed Counties -> Get Categories -> Get Feed.
- Feed and archive requests use feed_county_id so location lookups do not accidentally overwrite your content filters.
- For password resets, run Forgot Password, copy the token from the email link into reset_token, then use either Open Reset Password Page or Reset Password.
- For multipart requests like Create Submission and Update Profile, choose a real local file in Postman before sending.
- Admin is currently a Filament web panel under /admin, not a REST JSON API, so it is intentionally not included here.
- Do not import docs/figma-screen-collection.json into Postman. That file is a design audit reference, not a Postman collection.

request.description: Login with the seeded subscriber account. On success, the returned Sanctum token is saved into `auth_token`.
Fetch the authenticated user profile, active subscription summary, saved locations, and archive purchase summary.
Logout the current device token. Set `all_devices` to `true` to revoke all tokens.
Send a password reset link to the email in reset_email. Keep reset_email aligned with seeded_email, or point it at another existing account before sending.
Open the browser reset-password page with the token from the email link. Copy the token from the reset email into reset_token first.
Complete the password reset with the token from the email link. If reset_email matches seeded_email, this request also updates seeded_password to new_password for future login calls.

exec: if (resetEmail && seededEmail && resetEmail === seededEmail && newPassword) pm.environment.set('seeded_password', newPassword);

request.description: Fetch active countries for the location flow. This stores the first returned country id into country_id.
Fetch active regions for the selected location country. This stores the first returned region id into region_id.
Fetch counties for the selected location region. This stores the first returned county id into county_id for location saving only; feed requests use feed_county_id.
Reverse-geocode the provided coordinates, then store the detected location values in country_id, region_id, county_id, and detected_location_label. This does not change feed_county_id.
Save a user county selection after login. Run `Auto Detect Location` first if you want to post the detected ids and label automatically.
Fetch active categories with nested subcategories. The scripts prefer preferred_category_slug and preferred_subcategory_slug when available, otherwise they save the first matching ids.
Fetch active subcategories for the selected category. Run Get Categories first to populate category_id, or set it manually before sending.
Fetch the public county feed using feed_county_id. Run Get Feed Counties first so the collection points at the demo county instead of whichever location request last touched county_id.
Fetch counties available for feed switching. This searches with feed_county_search, then stores the best match in feed_county_id and feed_county_name.
Fetch a public live post detail. This same endpoint is also used for entitled archived posts.
Search archive content for the selected feed county and archive date. Run Get Feed Counties first so feed_county_id points at the same county as the public feed.
Record or verify archive access for the current feed_county_id and archive_date.

item.name: Get Archived Post Detail After Purchase

request.description: Fetch an archived post detail after archive access has been purchased.
Fetch the authenticated user archive purchase history, optionally filtered by the current feed_county_id.
Fetch the authenticated user's in-app notification inbox. The first notification id is saved into `notification_id`.
Register the current device for Firebase push notifications.
Mark a single notification as read. Run `List Notifications` first to capture `notification_id`.
Mark every notification in the current user's inbox as read.
Deactivate the current device token for push notifications.
Check the current user subscription state and whether submissions are enabled.
Create or verify an active subscription entitlement.

request.description: Submit subscriber content against feed_county_id. Run Get Feed Counties first so submissions target the same county as the feed and archive requests.
Fetch the current user's submission history and moderation status.

Update profile fields and optionally upload a profile image. This request is sent as multipart POST with `_method=PUT` for more reliable file upload handling in Postman. Pick a real local image file for `avatar`. Set `remove_avatar` to `true` if you want to clear the current image without uploading a replacement.
Soft delete the authenticated account and profile. This request requires the current account password.
